from pathlib import Path
from typing import Mapping, Union

import pandas as pd
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter


def _sanitize_sheet_name(name: str, used: set) -> str:
    invalid = set('[]:*?/\\')
    cleaned = "".join("_" if c in invalid else c for c in str(name)).strip("'") or "Sheet"
    cleaned = cleaned[:31]
    base, i = cleaned, 1
    while cleaned.lower() in used:
        suffix = f"_{i}"
        cleaned = base[: 31 - len(suffix)] + suffix
        i += 1
    used.add(cleaned.lower())
    return cleaned


def _format_sheet(worksheet, df: pd.DataFrame, max_width: int = 60) -> None:
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="305496", end_color="305496", fill_type="solid")
    for cell in worksheet[1]:
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    worksheet.freeze_panes = "A2"
    for idx, column in enumerate(df.columns, start=1):
        values = df[column].astype(str).tolist()
        longest = max([len(str(column))] + [len(v) for v in values])
        worksheet.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(idx)].width = min(longest + 2, max_width)


def export_report_to_xlsx(
    sections: Mapping[str, Union[pd.DataFrame, list, dict]],
    output_path: Union[str, Path],
) -> Path:
    output_path = Path(output_path)
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    used: set = set()
    with pd.ExcelWriter(output_path, engine="openpyxl") as writer:
        for name, data in sections.items():
            df = data if isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame) else pd.DataFrame(data)
            sheet = _sanitize_sheet_name(name, used)
            df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet, index=False)
            _format_sheet(writer.sheets[sheet], df)
        if not sections:
            pd.DataFrame().to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Sheet1", index=False)
    return output_path
